v02-winter-street.observed_description: A quiet village street under deep snow: snow on the roofs, the bare trees, the walls and the road, with icicles on a roof edge, under a pale gray sky. No people or cars.
v02-winter-street.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

v03-red-flower.observed_description: One large bright-red flower on a green stem grows in a plain clay pot on a wooden table against a plain pale background.
v03-red-flower.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The flower stands right of centre; it is whole and plain at 180 px.

v04-horse-eating.observed_description: One white horse stands in side view in a green field with its head lowered to the grass, eating. No people.
v04-horse-eating.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The horse's hindquarters are cut by the left edge; the lowered head eating grass is the plain subject.
